archetypes.name: dyn-fence-parser
archetypes.rationale: Change alters fence state-machine EOF handling and example-suppression regex breadth, with subtle false-negative/false-positive risk
archetypes.prompt_body: Scrutinize the python/lint_consecutive_bash.py changes. First the unclosed-opener handling in _parse_fences: skipping a malformed opener and rescanning from the next line must not infinite-loop, mis-handle indented or differently-marked fences, or wrongly merge bodies. Second the EXAMPLE_LABEL_RE narrowing in _is_example_fence: confirm the line-anchored label regex still suppresses every legitimate explicitly-labeled example fence while no longer suppressing real adjacent fences that merely sit near mid-sentence prose containing example/correct/wrong. Verify the interaction with _is_wrong_correct_pair still passes WRONG/CORRECT pairs, that no in-scope repo SKILL.md or references fence regresses, and that the four new tests pin the intended behavior rather than tautologies. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
